events.title: August draws to a close with 첼시 looking well placed to defend their Premier League title having won their first four games of the season. 스튜어트 피어스 's 맨체스터 시티 have made an impressive start to the season as they occupy second place. 찰턴 애슬레틱 , 맨체스터 유나이티드 and 볼턴 원더러스 complete the top five. Newly promoted 선덜랜드 are bottom after losing their first four games of the league season, with 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 and 포츠머스 completing the bottom three. 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 break their club transfer record by paying £17 million to 레알 마드리드 for 마이클 오언 . In the Championship, 셰필드 유나이티드 lead the table with Reading in second place, ahead of newly promoted 루턴 타운 on goal difference. 왓퍼드, 사우샘프턴 and 울버햄프턴 원더러스 complete the playoff places. 노리치 시티, narrowly relegated from the Premier League the previous season, have made a poor start to a campaign thought by many to be a challenge for an immediate return to England's elite and stand one place off the bottom of the Championship, sandwiched by 밀월 (bottom) and 셰필드 웬즈데이.

events.title: March draws to a close with 첼시 now nine points ahead of 맨체스터 유나이티드 at the top of the Premier League. 리버풀, 토트넘 홋스퍼, 블랙번 로버스 and 아스널 complete the top six, while 위건 애슬레틱 are now eighth and their dreams of European football are fading fast. 선덜랜드 are still bottom with 10 points though their relegation has yet to be confirmed. 포츠머스 and 버밍엄 시티 complete the bottom three, both of them being three points behind 17th-placed 웨스트브로미치 앨비언 and with a game in hand. Reading need only one more win from their last six games to confirm the Championship title, while 셰필드 유나이티드 appear almost certain to join Reading in the top flight. 왓퍼드, Leeds, 크리스털 팰리스 and 프레스턴 노스 엔드 complete the top six. At the other end of the table, Crewe and Brighton look dead and buried, needing four wins each from their last six games and other results to go their way to avoid relegation. 밀월 are only five points adrift in the relegation zone but still look bound for relegation as well, just two seasons after competing in the UEFA Cup .
